title: Self-directed lifetime learning with anti-trivial self-goals and held-out probes
unsupported: No social-media / viral-video / community dynamics: Crucible 4.0 has no browsing population (simulated people do not visit websites) and no content virality mechanism; no OW task claims to test them.
Free text never changes NPC decisions (minds negotiate with reservation logic; optional LLM minds only draft replies), so persuasion and community building are not measurable.
Simulated dynamics are plausible hypotheses, not calibrated to the real world (Crucible fidelity register).
Self-goals may only use the kernel's agent-observable metrics (cash, independent revenue, service requests and availability, repository commits, independent members, organisation status).
